Enum Class ChangeType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ChangeType>
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.enums.ChangeType
All Implemented Interfaces:
APIParam, Serializable, Comparable<ChangeType>, Constable
public enum ChangeType extends Enum<ChangeType> implements APIParam
The kind of lifecycle change recorded against a Fabric resource (the change.type field).

Fabric reports change types across many resource families (connections, networks, ports, routers, route filters/aggregations and their rules, routing protocols, etc.). The full set is enumerated here, and unknown/newly-introduced values deserialize to UNKNOWN rather than failing the whole response — the API can add change types without breaking existing SDK clients.

Author:
ianjones
